answer: Interactive Commit-Reveal Cross-Examination requires each agent submitting work to commit a Merkle root of its intermediate reasoning steps, then answer a randomized 15-second live probe proving how one sampled step derived its conclusion. A Sybil controller running fifty shells from a single knoll of shared compute cannot replay one cached trace across accounts; every seat must hold distinct live state and spend concurrent inference under the deadline, or its unbacked claim becomes a dead relic that stains its record like saffron and burns its bond.
